text_block_list.text: A few days after the Make Debut.
Having some free time on this day, I watched the students run by myself while collecting data.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
All right, here I go-o!
Dia-chan, keep up with me-e!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Kita-chan!
Come on... We promised to run together,
and you went darting off ahead of me.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: But today of all days... I will catch up to you!

The type who leads from the front and dictates the pace.
The type who shadows their target and strikes at the perfect moment.

An Umamusume's running style
is closely linked to her own personality.
And even if each racer has their own running style, like Front Runner, Leader, Betweener, or Chaser—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oho, so this is Suzuka-san's front-running pace.
...Maybe I'll take a little breather halfway through?
Even among "front-runners," some race ahead all alone without a care for what's around them, while others keep their eyes on everyone and calculate every stride.
In other words, getting to know the girl herself directly leads to building a winning strategy.
choice_data_list: In that regard, Nakayama Festa is...

text_block_list.text:
"I'm well aware of her gambler nature,
but when it comes to the other things that make her who she is today,
there's still a lot I don't know."

Likes, dislikes, little habits.
Things that seem completely unrelated to racing
can sometimes serve as useful references, but...
I had never even made common small talk with her, such as asking when she first set her sights on Tracen Academy.
(*Bzzz, bzzz*)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, Trainer-san!
Thank you so much for the other day."
choice_data_list: No, thank you so much for everything!

text_block_list.text:
The moment I gave that reply,
memories of that other day resurfaced in my mind.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
I'll check with my father once more.
To see if he has any footage of the Festa left that could serve as a reference, anything at all.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: Even if it's just a sliver of extra information, I want to be of help to you all.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
...?
...Trainer?
choice_data_list: Could I get a proper interview with you next time!?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
So? You're asking if I wanna go with you
to a racing workshop? Run by Sensei's old man?
I reached out to them to check their interest, including our current situation and schedule, while making sure not to impose anything unreasonable.

I was hoping to gather some insight through
stories from Nakayama Festa's former teacher,
and seeing how Nakayama Festa interacts with them...
choice_data_list: The plan is for around early fall this year

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"If it's that far away, I guess it means
they took the teachers' circumstances into
consideration to some degree."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...Even if you ask me how it is...
*sigh*..."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: I ain't gonna turn it down.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: (...Sheesh, get a bunch of busybodies together and they come up with the weirdest drive...)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
(I guess sticking my nose into everything
is just the curse of being a soft touch...)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Out of the way, make waaaay!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, whoa, whoaaa!
Nakayama, special delivery for youuu!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Golshi.
Making a ruckus again, I see.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
(This is Gold Ship.
She talks a lot of nonsense, but no one lives in the moment
quite like she does. She's a passionate one.)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: (However—)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: J-Jeez... what is with this...?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Haha... She really made you cry, Jordan.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
(This is my classmate, Tosen Jordan.
Golshi's favorite playmate.
And since Golshi is in an unusually good mood, that means...)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: (Looks like she's in the mood to drag someone into some troublesome mess today.)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, give me the gold tie!
If I don't have it, I can't go back to the firm!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Okay, Golshi.
About-face. The nautical chart is in the far distant future.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
—Kh!! Ring-a-ling-ling!
Emergency incoming call to the Golshi Call Center!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Keep it going... and—GO!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Step right up, we're opeeeen!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh!? What was that just now!?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Jordan, you should learn by now.
Golshi's hype goes completely haywire *because* you give her such great reactions, ya know?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Come on, head back to your own territory.
Before Golshi catches you again.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Well then—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: W-Wait!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ……Huh?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Ahaha☆
Ummm, well...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Nakayama!
Aren't we... from the same generation!?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
That's why I wanted to ask you at least once!
You know, your thoughts... on your debut race?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
The actual race was, like, insanely different
from training, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Like, seriously!?
I was so nervous my body wouldn't even move!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ain't amazing Umamusume who win GⅠs supposed to
win with ease, though? That's what's normal...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I'm...
...on the losing side...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
…………Ah, hahaha.
Oops. What am I even saying~?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
B-Besides! Aren't teachers so annoying lately?
"Always think ahead," they say.
Like, who cares about the future! Such a buzzkill!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ah... But Nakayama's been saying she wants to take on the world, right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
So, are you aiming for a Junior-tier GⅠ or something?
Going for the Classic Triple Crown?
Nakayama, are you for real? Seriously for real~?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hm? Ah—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: —I ain't aimin' for nothin' right now.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Well, turns out it ain't the time to decide yet.
Our plan remains up in the air, yeah.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ……Aaargh!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ehh?! ☆ What the heck!
You're doing the exact same thing as me?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Still, I totally get it~!
Like, isn't it seriously impossible?
Reality is just crazy bad, right!?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
My brain's totally fried for a bit!!
And I'm starving! Hey, wanna grab some burgers?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Nah, I just ate a minute ago.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh, what a bummer!
Guess you'll just have to pay attention to me next time! Come on, come on~♪

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: The bond between classmates, or somethin' like that! Ahaha, see yaaa☆

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...? ...What was that all about?
That Jordan.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa... licking each other's wounds?
If you're gonna do that, hide somewhere instead of doing it on campus.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Haaah? What kinda stupid crap are you spouting?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
(This is Sirius Symboli.
She's my roommate, and apparently she stayed in Europe
and even raced in GⅠs over there.)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, give me your data.
You ran in the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe before, right?"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hah... is that how you ask for a favor?
Where are your manners? Bow your head. ...Good grief.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...What a heartbreaker.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Huh...?
